# `ci.verification_runner_grant` — version 1.0

Source: `presets/ci/verification-runner-grant.satz`

## Purpose

Lets a verification runner act as this estate's IaC service account.

One IAM binding: the runner may mint tokens for the estate's service account
(`roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator`), which is the same right a human
operator holds through the svc-iac-users group. Nothing else — the runner gets
no role on the organisation, because it never acts as itself; satz exchanges
its identity for the estate's account before the first API call.

Separate from `ci/verification-runner.satz` because the two resources belong
to two parties in the hosted shape: the runner lives in the MSP's project,
this grant lives on the CUSTOMER's account, and the customer applies it.

Estate wiring: nothing to set when the runner pack is used in the same estate
— the default names its service account. With the runner elsewhere, set
ci_runner_service_account to that runner's email.

## Use it

```
params {
  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  ci_runner_service_account = "satz-runner@{ci_runner_project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

use "presets/ci/verification-runner-grant.satz"
```

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `ci_runner_project` — declared by `ci.verification_runner`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `infra_project_name` — no pack in the library declares it, so the estate must.
- `svc_iac_account` — no pack in the library declares it, so the estate must.

## Params

| param | default |
|---|---|
| `ci_runner_service_account` | `"satz-runner@{ci_runner_project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"` |
